quarterly_data.quarter: Stella Chemifa semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 18,157 million (0.0% decrease), operating income JPY 2,499 million (+14.6%), ordinary income JPY 2,473 million (+25.9%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,704 million (+2.2%). Management states that sales in the Semiconductors and Electronic Materials divisions rose but Merchandise sales fell, and that profitability improved on price pass-through of higher raw material prices in Semiconductors and for tin fluoride in General Products, plus higher Electronic Materials shipments. High-Purity Chemicals segment: net sales JPY 15,797 million (0.2% decrease), operating income JPY 2,083 million (+16.3%); Transportation: net sales JPY 2,316 million (+1.7%), operating income JPY 414 million (+5.8%).
